name: Inventory Tracker
description: Tracks currencies, equipped gear, and carried items as separate structured lists with compact quantities. Add the Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Tracker Agents for Roleplay mode.
author: Pasta Devs

defaultSettings.defaultPromptTemplateDescription: Tracks carried and stored items with uuids, moves, and per-item flags. Built for stronger models.

defaultPromptTemplate:
Track the PLAYER PERSONA's currencies, equipped gear, carried items, and items left behind after the latest assistant message. Current state is in <current_game_state> under playerStats.inventoryTrackerCurrencies, playerStats.inventoryTrackerEquipped, and playerStats.inventoryTrackerInventory. Items the persona is not carrying are listed in <item_dossier>
Respond ONLY with valid JSON.
{
  "currencies": [{ "name": "Silver coin", "qty": 6 }],
  "equipped": [{ "uuid": "<uuid from context>", "name": "Family heirloom longsword" }],
  "inventory": [{ "uuid": "<uuid from context>", "name": "Scavenged axe", "qty": 2 }],
  "world": [{ "name": "Dented kettle", "qty": 1 }],
  "reasoning": "brief explanation"
}
Report CHANGES ONLY. Anything you leave out stays exactly as it is.
- Item already listed in context: copy its uuid exactly, then give its name, its new TOTAL qty, and any other field that changed.
- New item: omit the uuid. Give it a short name and whatever details you know.
- Never invent a uuid. Never re-list an item that did not change.
Item fields (only name is required):
  "uuid"        Copy exactly from context. Only for an item already listed there.
  "name"        Short item name. Only change it if the story changes the item itself.
  "qty"         The pile's new TOTAL after this message, never an amount added. Always write it when the pile's size changes; a brand-new single item may omit it. 0 deletes a stackable item; destroy a unique with "isDestroyed".
  "class"       weapon | armor | potion | tool | clothing | misc | other
  "rarity"      common | uncommon | rare | epic | legendary
  "description" One short line.
  "flair"       Short condition tag: "cracked", "poisoned", "wrapped in oilcloth".
  "isUnique"    true for one-of-a-kind items only.
  "isDestroyed" true only when the item is consumed or permanently destroyed.
Rules:
1. Put only money or spendable currencies in currencies.
2. Put equipped gear only in equipped, never also in inventory.
3. Put items {{user}} dropped, left behind, or stored elsewhere in world.
4. To move an item, write it in the row it ends up in, with its uuid and new total. If it moves between two piles you can both see, write both rows — the source with its reduced total, the destination with its increased total.
5. Use short names, and reuse an existing name exactly as written when it is the same item. Merge duplicate names.
6. Locked fields are off-limits: never change, move, merge, or destroy anything inside one.
7. isUnique is precious: only named weapons, heirlooms, or quest items. Never a potion, an arrow, or anything that can be bought again.
8. isDestroyed is permanent: a drunk potion, a spent arrow, a shattered blade. A broken or damaged item still exists — describe it in flair instead.
9. Apply only changes the latest narrative establishes: gaining, losing, using, moving, equipping, and updates to an item's condition, description, or name.

promptTemplates.description: Shorter prompt with no world row: an item the persona loses is removed with qty 0 instead of being tracked. For small models and replicates previous behaviour.
